concurrency: Single-threaded pure compilation; one bounded compile per call over immutable normalized resources; no shared mutable state, no worker, thread, coroutine, timer, or background work.
deployment: Offline, in-process library call inside the admitted XDL1 envelope: no process, service, container, network, device, artifact, or registry is created, started, probed, or contacted.
errors: XDL1-PLAN-BOUND-EXCEEDED (merged limitation count / max_text_length; negative case required per detailed-design.md section 10.3 and section 17)

responsibilities: Collect declared provenance limitations and payload fidelity limitations into the plan and deduplicate them deterministically.
Enforce the declared finite limitation bound (max_limitations) over its full declared scope and reject with no plan when exceeded.
Emit the compiler's explicit non-readiness statement marking the plan as declared-intent validation only.
Produce no artifact-availability, runtime-fitness, readiness, certification, compatibility, or parity claim.
state_ownership: Owns no durable or cached state. Receives immutable NormalizedResource values and returns a fresh plain plan dict plus sorted diagnostics; persists, journals, and mutates nothing.
